column6: eval (() => {   const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('table.wikitable tr'));   const tungstenRow = rows.find(row => row.textContent.includes('Tungsten'));   if (!tungstenRow) return 'Not found in table.wikitable tr';   return Array.from(tungstenRow.querySelectorAll('td, th')).map(el => el.textContent.trim()); })()

eval (() => {   const table = document.querySelector('table.wikitable');   if (!table) return 'No table';   const headers = Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('thead tr th, tr:first-child th, tr:nth-child(2) th')).map(el => el.textContent.trim());   return headers; })()
